name: hook-plate
title: Hook Plate
description: Opening hook of a vertical reel: the speaker's first phrase in upper case, one size for every hook (6% of the frame height), one line within the readable width or two at a whole word, centred on a black rounded plate with equal padding on all sides, under the opening circle (a tall plate rises onto its lower edge); on screen from the first frame. Text, cues and exit are variables; mount over the whole frame.
